title: Hueston's Huestonry for Huestoning
description:
Adds Hueston, Jamesson and Walterson to the game
They are little fella's who enjoy life and have a civil war with each other... wait wh-
body:
Hueston is a purple lil fella who loves his holy block, if you break it, he will haunt you, Hueston does not like players.

There is also Jamesson, Hueston's rival, Hueston does not like Jamesson because Jamesson has more style, they also both have a biome, the Jamesson forest and the Hueston lands, but Hueston's biome never generates, that makes him sad.

Then you have Waltersson, everyone's favorite, even though nobody knows that Waltesrsson was the true villain all along!

What does this mod add?
- Paintings
- Mobs
- Blocks
- A single command that heals you (I am NOT good at coding commands) 
- Biomes
- Dimensions
- Spawn eggs
- Hueston
- Jamesson
- Waltersson
And more coming soon!
